_comment: Committed attribution map for the seven public-domain voices used by the harmonization sweep. text_sources.attribution is NULL in bible_reference.db for all seven, so author/work/year are hand-authored here. full_name is copied verbatim from text_sources for traceability. license_code is the DB's assertion (all PD); the sweep re-checks it at runtime.

TYN.flag: OWNER REVIEW: name + missing year are atypical for a public-domain-by-age work. DB asserts license_code=PD, so it passes the gate, but its 'dated' attribution is unresolved. Recommend confirming provenance/date before shipping any TYN excerpt.

GNV.flag: kind=translation, not commentary: the 'notes' are the Geneva annotators' marginal glosses (short). Attribute to the translation, not an individual.
